description: Current XCH spot price via CoinGecko. Accepts any currency CoinGecko supports (e.g. 'usd', 'eur', 'gbp', 'jpy', 'btc', 'eth'); defaults to ['usd']. Free-tier API is rate-limited; results are cached for 60 seconds.

currencies.description: Fiat or crypto currency codes accepted by CoinGecko (e.g. 'usd', 'eur', 'gbp', 'jpy', 'btc', 'eth'). Case-insensitive. Defaults to ['usd'].

name: get_xch_price
